fishing: WHEN: early/moving tides best. PASSES-BEACH: snook (C&R), redfish, tarpon/sharks Stump Pass/Manasota; jacks, pompano. LEMON BAY: redfish schools, snook docks, trout. NEARSHORE: mangrove/lane snapper, grunts, grouper. Baits: live shrimp, pinfish, cut bait, soft plastics.
redtide: FWC: K. brevis not observed statewide past week; no SWFL bloom.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD (~20 CFU latest); Charlotte sites clear.
